title: canonical.rs NUL+LF separator is immune to header value injection
description: core/canonical.rs uses 0x00+0x0A as the header/body separator. RFC 5322 forbids NUL in header values and allows LF only as part of CRLF folding, so this separator cannot appear in a valid header field. The boundary is therefore unambiguous and injection-resistant. Do not simplify to CRLF+CRLF — that is parseable out of a crafted header.
